description: §13.9.1 rule 4 (RULED S478): a whole-cell author write into a pending tape needs `replace` in the tape's grants — spelled `(not to User[replace])`. A `let` pending tape loads on mount ("ab"); the handler writes the cell whole (`@users = [v]`), which the type's `replace` grants ("r"). Without `[replace]` the same write is E-WRITE-NOT-GRANTED (lifecycle/pending-tape-whole-write-not-granted-pos). The load's settle write needs no grant (rule 5). RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real".
rationale: §13.9.1 rule 4, RULED S478: "a whole-cell author write into a pending tape, `let` or locked, needs `replace` in the tape's grants (`(not to S[replace])`) like any other tape, and without it is **E-WRITE-NOT-GRANTED**. The load's own writes are rule 5's, and a reset (§6.8) re-runs the load (§13.9.2), so neither needs `replace`." §66.11.2 item 3: `replace` is its own explicit grant. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S478 "⭐ RULED — S477 owner questions 1 and 2, PA recs adopted" item 1.
